messages:
alex: Cutting RC from main now (rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03). Requesting pin + QA sign-off for promo window 11:00-12:00 UTC. Short checklist: pin artifact, run quick smoke, set canary to 10%, kv-warm, monitor dashboards. pls ack.

maya: Ack, starting smoke on staging now. I saw one flaky embed test earlier but not related to serving layer.

sam_qa: Smoke started. Running these checks: health, simple chat gen, kv load. ETA ~8m. Will paste failures if any.

paul_eng: I can do the pin once smoke green. Pin command is in our release tool:```/release pin rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03 --repo inference-runtime --sha=ab12cd34```

deploybot: [bot] rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03 created by alex (sha ab12cd34). Artifact: rwinfer:v2026-03-03-rc. Canary default 0%.

maya: Smoke green for basic flows. KV warm OK. Observability shows normal latencies. Noted increased 95p on one GPU host but within previous canary baseline.

paul_eng: Pinning now.```/release pin rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03 --env prod --commit ab12cd34``` :white_check_mark:

jay_oncall: Heads up — rolling forward criteria: error spike > 3x baseline for 2m or latency p95 increase > 200ms sustained for 5m. Rollback lifeboat ready: route back to previous canary (rwinfer:v2026-02-28). I put rollback steps in the runbook.

alex: @paul_eng please set canary to 10% after pin and create the traffic toggle (manual) so ops can lift to 50 if stable. Also add a short release-notes blurb: "RC created for shrinkwrap changes; performance and batching fixes."

paul_eng: Canary set to 10% and traffic toggle created:```curl -X POST https://ops-api/release/canary -d '{"rc":"rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03","percent":10}'```

sam_qa: Running post-pin smoke against canary. Quick regression harness: chat prompt x100, embeddings x50, memcache small burst. Reporting results in 3m.

maya: Telemetry looks good so far. No new error classes. I see one 500 returned from a downstream service at 11:02 UTC but it was transient.

deploybot: [bot] Promo window requested for 11:00-12:00 UTC. Schedule queued. To promote run:```/release promote rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03 --target prod --window 11:00-12:00```

alex: Given smoke + telemetry, I'm calling for sign-off. @maya @sam_qa can you +1?

maya: +1 :thumbsup:

sam_qa: +1. No blocking regressions seen.

paul_eng: Locking the candidate: write-lock applied to deploy-configs. Adding pin note to changelog.

jay_oncall: Oncall ready to watch the rollout. I've set a pager rule for the new service errors and a slack alert to #incidents if threshold crossed.

alex: ok launching promo at 11:05 UTC (moving window slightly to let last logs settle). I'll run the promote command at 11:05.

deploybot: [bot] Promotion scheduled: rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03 -> prod at 11:05 UTC. Operator: alex.

paul_eng: Reminder: rollback commands in runbook quick section:```/release rollback --to rwinfer:v2026-02-28 --reason "auto-rollback"``` and the traffic-shim toggle is at ops-console -> Releases -> shrinkwrap-2026-03-03.

alex: Promote started. Running step 1 (canary expand to 30%). Will watch 5m window.

maya: 1m into canary expand. Metrics stable. No error increase.

sam_qa: 3m - no functional regressions from smoke set. continuing to watch.

paul_eng: Canary at 50% now per manual lift. Heatmap and tracer show no outliers.

alex: Final expand to 100% in 2m if stable.

deploybot: [bot] Promotion progress: 30% -> 50% -> 100% complete. All steps completed.

jay_oncall: All clear from pager side. No alert fires.

maya: :shipit: Looks good from QA.

sam_qa: Marking RC as promoted in tracking doc. Will follow up with a short post-deploy eval tomorrow.

alex: Thanks team — closing this RC. Notes: pin applied, canary lift timeline recorded, rollback lifeboat in runbook.

deploybot: [bot] Thread closed for rc/shrinkwrap-2026-03-03.
